AccountSession.name: __Host-mkeai_session
AccountSession.description: Opaque HttpOnly session credential. PostgreSQL stores SHA256 digest. No shared Bearer/JWT/refresh. Explicit loopback HTTP development uses mkeai_dev_session instead.

Auth01Csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
Auth01Csrf.description: Synchronizer nonce for this cookie context, required for every unsafe request including logout.

Auth01Origin.name: Origin
Auth01Origin.description: Exact configured trusted origin; null/missing/evil origin rejected, no Referer or CLI bypass.

Auth01IfMatch.name: If-Match
Auth01IfMatch.description: One exact strong AdminUser ETag; missing428, invalid400, stale412.

Auth01ContextCookie.name: __Host-mkeai_session
Auth01ContextCookie.description: Browser-managed HttpOnly context; login requires unexpired preauth, logout accepts retained context with matching nonce. Not a user Bearer credential. Explicit dev alias mkeai_dev_session.
